about.label: FullStack Web Developer
about.title: About
about.introLead: I design and build websites that look beautiful, load fast and bring in clients.
about.intro: I'm Julián Recarte, a FullStack web developer. I help businesses and brands with custom landing pages, corporate sites, catalogs and ecommerce, taking care of what matters most: fast loading, turning visitors into clients, and being easy to find for people, search engines and AI models.
about.metaDescription: Julián Recarte, FullStack web developer. Custom landing pages, sites, catalogs and ecommerce. 100% remote, in Spanish, English and Italian.
about.teaserText: I'm a FullStack web developer working 100% remotely with clients worldwide, in Spanish, English and Italian. I turn ideas into fast, well-crafted websites built to deliver results.

facts.label: Services
facts.value: Landing pages · Corporate sites · Catalogs · Ecommerce · Custom admin panels

faq.a: I design and develop landing pages, corporate sites, digital catalogs, ecommerce and custom admin panels. I also integrate subscription systems, newsletters and payments.
Yes. I work 100% remotely with clients worldwide, in Spanish, English and Italian.

faq.q: How long does a project take?
faq.a: A landing page is usually ready in 1 to 2 weeks; a site with a catalog or ecommerce takes 3 to 6 weeks, depending on scope and content.
Mainly Astro, Tailwind CSS, GSAP, Supabase, Node.js and TypeScript. I choose the technology based on what each project needs.

faq.q: Can I edit the site myself?
faq.a: Yes. When the project needs it, I build a custom admin panel so you can manage content, products or orders without depending on a developer.
Message me on WhatsApp or email with your idea. We do a briefing, I propose an approach and a budget, and we get started.

principles.title: Performance first
principles.text: Every site is built to load fast on any device and connection. Speed isn't an extra: it's what keeps your visitors around and improves your search ranking.

principles.title: Detail in every pixel
principles.text: Typography, spacing, animations and accessibility crafted with care. A polished site conveys the same trust you want your brand to convey.

principles.title: Direct communication
principles.text: You talk to me, no middlemen. I keep you updated at every stage, in Spanish, English or Italian, and I reply fast.

about.closingText: Tell me your idea and I'll get back to you with an approach and a quote. No strings attached.

triba.title: Triba
triba.description: Development of a complete digital magazine: subscription system, automated newsletter, editions catalog, and a contributor program with application form. Editorial design with smooth navigation and comfortable reading on any device.
triba.subtitle: Digital magazine with subscription system, automated newsletter and contributor program.
triba.challenge: The magazine needed far more than a website: managing subscriptions, sending an automatic newsletter with each edition, archiving published issues and offering a contributor program. All with comfortable reading on any device.
triba.solution: I designed a responsive, intuitive editorial platform: subscriptions integrated with an automated newsletter, an archive of past issues and a contributor program that simplifies onboarding new authors.
triba.plus: I built a custom admin panel so the team can publish editions, manage subscribers and handle all the content in both languages (Spanish and English) easily, without depending on a developer.

sp-soluciones-textiles.subtitle: Landing page with service catalog and direct WhatsApp connection.

multiservizi.title: Multiservizi SRL
multiservizi.description: Italian funeral home offering wholesale products: ceramics, coffins, decorations and more. Complete digital catalog with smooth navigation.
multiservizi.subtitle: Wholesale platform for a funeral home in Calabria: digital catalog, client panel and admin panel with sales statistics.
multiservizi.challenge: Petrungaro Multiservizi sold funeral products wholesale —ceramics, coffins, decorations— with manual order management. It needed an organized digital catalog for its clients and a clear way to track what sells.
multiservizi.solution: I designed a platform with a wholesale catalog, a client panel to browse products and place orders, and an admin panel to manage products, clients and orders from a single place.
multiservizi.plus: The admin panel includes sales statistics charts to spot trends and best-selling products, with full self-management without depending on a developer.
